name: Frame Window Counter
description: A frame window counter and label tool.

open-editor-key.name: Open / Close Editor
open-editor-key.description: Opens the Frame Window Editor, or closes it (and any Frame Window popup) if one is already open. Works anywhere in the game, same as the old hardcoded O key.

add-frame-key.name: Add 1-Frame Window
add-frame-key.description: Adds a 1-frame window for player 1 on the CURRENT tick of the level you are playing. Does nothing if that tick already has a 1P frame.

add-frame-open-key.name: Add 1-Frame Window + Open Editor
add-frame-open-key.description: Does the same as 'Add 1-Frame Window', then opens the Frame Window Editor and scrolls to the new frame (like pressing O).

undo-frame-key.name: Undo Last Keybind Frame
undo-frame-key.description: Removes the most recent frame that was added with one of the Add 1-Frame Window keybinds. (Default is Y: GD itself uses Z/X for practice-mode checkpoints, so those are best avoided.)

keybind-frame-offset.name: Keybind Frame Offset
keybind-frame-offset.description: Added to the current tick when a keybind adds a frame. 0 = exactly the tick shown by the mod. Use 1 to place the frame on the next physics step if you press slightly after the input.

keybind-auto-recalc.name: Auto-Recalculate L* After Keybind
keybind-auto-recalc.description: Automatically restart the L* calculation after a keybind adds or removes a frame, so the HUD values and Base L* % stay up to date. Can be slow on very large macros.

audio-buffer-size.name: Audio Buffer Size
audio-buffer-size.description: Size (in samples) of the SFX mixer's buffer. Lower = sounds play sooner, higher = safer against crackling on slow machines. 512 is a good balance; try 256 for the lowest delay or 1024 if you hear crackling.

use-legacy-audio.name: Use Legacy Audio Engine
use-legacy-audio.description: Turns off the new SFX mixer and plays each sound as its own FMOD channel like before 1.4.0 (max 32 overlapping per sound, so fast macros will cut sounds off). Only enable this if the new mixer misbehaves on your system.
